7 July
A theme for reflection

No major event recorded for this date

Our records hold no well-supported event for this day. It is offered instead as a day to reflect on the Gurus’ teaching and on seva in daily life.

This day has no single recorded event in our records; the theme above is offered for reflection.

No single event is recorded for 7 July in our calendar, so the day is offered for reflection on the theme below.

Sources and further reading

  • Harbans Singh (ed.), The Encyclopaedia of Sikhism, 4 vols, Punjabi University, Patiala, 1992–1998.
  • Khushwant Singh, A History of the Sikhs, 2 vols, Oxford University Press, 1963–1966 (2nd ed. 2004).
  • J. S. Grewal, The Sikhs of the Punjab, The New Cambridge History of India, Cambridge University Press, 1990 (rev. 1998).
  • Kahn Singh Nabha, Gur Shabad Ratnakar Mahan Kosh, 1930.

Background sections are written by SikhsInIndia.com from the works listed. Dates in Sikh history sometimes differ between sources and between the Nanakshahi and older Bikrami calendars. To suggest a correction, write to sikhsinindia@gmail.com.

July in Sikh History

  • Jul 1Martyrdom day of Bhai Taru Singh Ji, in Lahore
  • Jul 2No major event recorded for this date
  • Jul 3No major event recorded for this date
  • Jul 4Indian police entered Darbar Sahib complex and arrested several Akali leaders
  • Jul 5Prakash Purab of Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji
  • Jul 6Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru assured fruits of freedom for Sikhs
  • Jul 7No major event recorded for this date
  • Jul 8Maharaja Ripudaman Singh Nabha forced to abdicate his throne
  • Jul 9The foundation stone of 12 feet high Akal Bunga (Sri Akal Takhat Sahib) was laid by Sri Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji himself in front of the harimandir Sahib The five story building was completed in 1609
  • Jul 10Akali leadership formally took up the question of the restoration of Maharaja of Nabha
  • Jul 11Guru Tegh Bahadur left Anandpur Sahib for Delhi to help save Hindu dharma from total extinction
  • Jul 12Guru Tegh Bahadur along with leading personages of his Darbar, Dewan Mati Das, Sati Das, and Dayal Das, were taken into custody at village Malikpur Ranghran, Pargana Ghanaula near Ropar
  • Jul 13Sikhs under Kanwar Peshora Singh conquered and occupied Attock
  • Jul 14The British government issued a communique
  • Jul 15Sikhs, under the leadership of Jai Singh, establish complete control over PahadGanj and JaiSinghPura, Delhi
  • Jul 16No major event recorded for this date
  • Jul 17Sardar Teja Singh Samundri passed away in Lahore Fort as a result of the strain from the lengthy detention there
  • Jul 18No major event recorded for this date
  • Jul 19No major event recorded for this date
  • Jul 20Akali Dal Executives asks its legislatures to form a separate group in the Assembly
  • Jul 21The police and army of Nabha State lifted the seize of Gurudwara Gangsar and Tibhi Sahib Jaito in 1925
  • Jul 22Foundation stone of Paonta Fort laid by Guru Gobind Singh Ji
  • Jul 23Prakash Purab of Guru Harkrishan Sahib Ji
  • Jul 24Baba Gurdit Singh, leader of Koma-Gata Maru passed away
  • Jul 25Bahadur Shah ordered Pheroj Khan, Muyarif Khan, and Shikar Khan to arrest Baba Banda Singh Bahadur
  • Jul 26No major event recorded for this date
  • Jul 27Janam Utsav, Shaheed Baba Jorawar Singh Ji
  • Jul 28Punjab Governor gave his assent to the Sikh Gurudwara Act
  • Jul 29Sardar Sadhu Singh Hamdard, Editor of Punjab’s voice, Ajit, daily newspaper, died of a heart attack
  • Jul 30Sangat Singh, son of Fateh Singh became Raja of Jind
  • Jul 31Agreement reached between the Dal Khalsa and Maharaja Vijay Singh of Jodhpur
